name: s3_braking_lead_vehicle
description: Scenario 3: the lead car brakes. Both cars drive 50 km/h, the lead car 25 m ahead (pivot to pivot). After 3 s of its own time the lead car brakes at 6 m/s^2 to a stop. The scripted driver does not react, so without a working safety system the ego car hits it from behind.
